limitations: Source observation time can be a year anchor rather than the actual reported week (NL, TH history, CO). Do not interpret time maxima as actual latest weeks.
PublicDiseaseSeries DB cache is not the online source of truth. Live default summaries and live source detail inventories were both checked.
DB subnational source observations are often stored under parent-country series and geography keys; an absent subdivision series country_code is not missing ingestion.
Missing weekly OR monthly separately does not imply a missing source: preserve source native grain; do not split annual data or sum overlapping source strata.
